6ece8953664f1897b245a922130d0770.title: Study wild ramification in arboreal Galois representations

6ece8953664f1897b245a922130d0b7f.body: Say something interesting about wild ramification for arboreal representations. e.g. study Galois representations over local fields of residue characteristic dividing degree of $f$ (or even less than or equal to the degree). e.g. An arboreal version of Sen's theorem.

6ece8953664f1897b245a922130d1541.body: Let $f(z)=z^2+1$ over $\mathbb{Q}_2.$ What is the size, etc, of the arboreal representation?
